featured_reviews.name: Neha Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Got menu printed for our Restaurant. Very impressed with the quality of the print and also would like to thank Harish bhai for great support during the entire printing process. He understood all our requirements very well and provided all the service in time.
Rates are also quite reasonable.

Thank you for all your support.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: THANK U SIR

featured_reviews.name: Karan Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely impressed with deluxe zerox!  The process was super quick and efficient. No unnecessary delays, no complicated steps.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: THANK U SIR

featured_reviews.name: Sarah Sequeira
featured_reviews.review_text: The experience was great and the print quality is excellent too!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank u Madam 😊

featured_reviews.name: Greg Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: Very bad xerox center, the quality of the xerox was so bad and in front of the shopkeeper eyes, yet he started arguing instead try to get a better one. Also, keeps commenting on customers once they are gone. Will upload the xerox in a while

featured_reviews.name: Lawrence Vaz
featured_reviews.review_text: Very pathetic experience, service very bad, told to remove printout single page not back to back but still removed back to back. xerox machine got jammed, no servicing done, had to wait for more that 2 hours. Two times I had gone Saturday and Monday, same problem again.  Every worker out there gets arrogant. Customers kindly check other xerox shops

featured_reviews.name: BEENA UPADHYAY
featured_reviews.review_text: Services are excellent and also staffs are very proffessional and doing wonderful job . Had given brochure for printing  wanted in urgent they have given me before time. Would visit deluxe xerox for  all kind of printing jobs.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank u madam and we as a Deluxe Xerox staff will always ensure to give u the best of service

featured_reviews.name: Shalem
featured_reviews.review_text:
Have been here for photocopy and lamination.
The quality of the photocopies was good.
Rates are also good.
You can find other photocopy shops close by to this place. The service has been good when I visited.

featured_reviews.name: Salima Amin
featured_reviews.review_text: Ther service is very good and they work with accuracy, but pls put your rates also on the site
